name: [REVAMP] Vanguard Site
desc:
Assigned to Vanguard Site, one of the last standing facilities containing subjects to find a cure.

Join our server and group for update logs and sneak peaks
Recommended to play on a laptop or PC

Be a subject, cause chaos in the facility and attempt to escape.
Be staff, protect the facility and enforce rules on subjects

Premium players obtain a 1.5x reputation boost

Please make sure to follow rules when playing.
Exploiting will result in a permanent ban.
